links.outcome: Model performance drop in external validation versus test set

links.quote: Performance drop in external validation (EXVAL) likely reflects population differences (AUC range: 0.55-0.72).

links.outcome: Physician prediction accuracy with versus without XAI decision support tool
links.effect: Lung expert and nonexpert physicians improved their prediction when using the XAI ML CB-only tool; no numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: The clinical usability study showed that lung expert and nonexpert physicians improved their prediction with the explainable AI (XAI) ML CB-only based tool.
